microsoft/markitdown is a research lead for converting approved source documents into structured Markdown for SEO/content workflows. Evidence: MIT license, bounded CRO lab fit supported, 8/8 available checks passed, no dependency installation or production access; repository maintenance, transitive dependencies, parser fidelity, source rights, and content-quality risk remain unvalidated. Smallest reversible prototype, when capacity and gates clear: convert a small owner-approved fixture set in a disposable workspace, compare heading/link/table fidelity and editorial preparation time against the current workflow, and discard artifacts after review. No production adoption, external content ingestion, or deployment is recommended now.
